name: memory_graph_recall
description: Traverse Spector's knowledge graph across multi-hop entity relationships (GraphRAG). Discovers connections between entities through explicit facts (TemporalKnowledgeGraph) and co-occurrence hyperedges (HyperEntityGraph). Supports start entity targeting, pathfinding to a target entity, max hops bounding (1-5), entity type filtering (e.g., 'PERSON,ORGANIZATION,PROJECT'), and relation type filtering (e.g., 'works_at,leads'). Returns structured relational paths grounded in supporting cognitive memory text.

start_entity.description: Focal entity name to begin traversal from (e.g. 'Alice', 'Sarah Chen'). If omitted, entities are inferred from 'query'.

query.description: Natural language query or keywords used to discover starting entities when 'start_entity' is not provided.

target_entity.description: Optional destination entity to find relational path(s) to (point-to-point traversal).

max_hops.description: Maximum traversal depth in hops (1-5, default: 3).

entity_types.description: Comma-separated list of entity types to filter by (e.g. 'PERSON,PROJECT,ORGANIZATION').

relation_types.description: Comma-separated list of relation / predicate types to filter by (e.g. 'works_at,leads,located_in').

include_memories.description: Whether to include grounding text excerpts from linked cognitive memories (default: true).

top_paths.description: Maximum number of discovered relational paths to return (1-50, default: 10).

as_of.description: ISO-8601 timestamp for point-in-time temporal queries (e.g., '2025-06-15T00:00:00Z'). When provided, only facts valid at this timestamp are traversed.

include_superseded.description: Whether to include superseded (retracted) facts in traversal (default: false).
